scope: published 768 Wide MER HATS leaves, catalogue rows; not measured clean imaging area
preregistered_from: 2026-11-19 source replay of 24 matched z>6.5 quasars and 14 matched spectroscopic dwarf controls

selection_rule.VIS_DET_requirement: none (VIS detection flag and aperture SNR are different quantities)
selection_rule.J_H_flag_requirement: not hard veto, recorded and downranked
selection_rule.signed_VIS_requirement: absolute aperture SNR to avoid falsely treating negative noise excursions as a detection

guaranteed_output_policy: top 200 by deterministic score per source partition, sufficient to recover all global top 200; exact pass counts for all rows
qualification: Labels are used to choose a relaxed high-recall screen. Measured matched-control recovery is resubstitution, not held-out completeness; dwarf fraction from 14 nonrepresentative labels is not field purity.
vetoes_for_second_stage: inspect VIS/NISP pixels, optical associations, CatWISE/unWISE motion and colours, literature and actual public spectra; do not mistake unavailable response for nondetection
